name: A Brief Inquiry Into Online Relationships

info.desc: A Brief Inquiry into Online Relationships is the third studio album by English band The 1975. It was released on 30 November 2018 by Dirty Hit and Polydor Records. Initially titled "Music for Cars", the album was intended as the follow-up to "I Like It When You Sleep, for You Are So Beautiful yet So Unaware of It". The term later denoted an era encompassing both their third album and "Notes on a Conditional Form", released in 2020. The band halted recording of the first part after lead singer Matthew Healy left for a drug rehabilitation clinic in Barbados, seeking .
